name: Chen Nan Iron Wire Co.,Ltd
summary: Based in Taiwan, Chen Nan Iron Wire Co.,Ltd is a prominent manufacturer and global supplier of diverse fasteners and steel wire products. Their extensive fastener portfolio encompasses a wide array of screws, including self-drilling, chipboard, roofing, drywall, self-tapping, collated, concrete, decking, wood, furniture, window, stainless steel, machine, set, trilobular thread-forming, socket cap, SEMS, and nail screws, alongside specialized screw types. The company also produces various bolts, such as carriage, flange, hexagonal, and lag bolts, while their nut selection comprises hex flange, cage, hexagonal, wing, nylon, square, dome cap, and panel nuts. For washers, options range from bonding, external tooth lock, flat, internal tooth lock, spring lock, and umbrella types. Beyond fasteners, Chen Nan Iron Wire Co.,Ltd supplies alloy, stainless steel, and carbon steel wires, in addition to nails, hose clamps, and rivets. Their products are distributed internationally, reaching markets across Europe, the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Asia, and the Middle East. Established in 1992, the firm is headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.
